title: GAINS BY ANY MEANS NECESSARY! (Demonic Muscle Motivation: Toguro x Yuyu Hakusho)
summary: Short manga/anime motivation edit built from Yu Yu Hakusho scenes of Toguro's muscle transformation, with no commentary from NH. The title and tags frame it as discipline and lifting motivation.
claims: The title frames Toguro's muscle transformation in Yu Yu Hakusho as motivation to pursue gains by any means necessary
The chosen scenes push the idea that lacking the guts to pay the price is why people don't get what they want, and that strength trumps technique
